description: Slay the Spire Act 1 (Ironclad) -- SKELETON ONLY.  Two hand-written statuses, no cards, no enemy actions, no encounters, no relics, no map.  It exists to prove that a second package travels the whole chain (source -> compile -> image -> reader round-trip) under its own file names, without touching the roguedeck baseline.  Nothing in this package is kernel-verified yet, so it has no expected_sha.txt pin.
